description: User switches to annotate mode, draws a shape (lasso, polyline, or point), names it. Client sends REST POST. Server creates the annotation file with slug filename and canonical sorted-key JSON. Server registers the kind if new. Server broadcasts annotation change to all clients.
label: Annotation Create to Persist

members.note: Switches canvas from select to annotate mode.
Stores the drawn shape before the user commits it.
Client state action. Calls REST POST.
Generates UUID, writes {slug}.json with sortKeys canonical JSON.
Registers the kind if absent. Assigns deterministic colour from name hash.
